== Biography ==
Grissell was born before 1752. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1023|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Mill-357|Janet Mill]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-1023]] is assessed at 85% (probable). The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms index entry for Grissell Glasgow, 18 June 1752 at Livingston (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/21027715), reads the parent fields that the previous review could not see: father Thomas and mother Janet (forenames only). It belongs to the Thomas Glasgow and Janet Mill family of Livingston attached as Thomas [[Glasgow-1023]], whose other children's transcripts name the full couple. Confidence rises to 85%.

The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms rows are Ancestry's copy of the FamilySearch Scotland Births and Baptisms index already cited, so they verify the indexed parent fields rather than adding an independent source; the original register is uninspected. The row gives the mother's forename only. Thomas-1023's identification with the 1725 Kilwinning child remains inferred and is not addressed by this record. No mother change follows.
